name: prompt-it
description: Perform automatic proportional planning for substantial tasks and draft an evidence-backed execution brief before implementation. Ask first or Just go mode controls implementation approval.

interface.shortDescription: Plan automatically. Ask first reviews the plan; Just go proceeds under original authority.
interface.longDescription: Perform automatic proportional planning, research the approved task read-only, and produce an evidence-backed execution brief with explicit model staffing and economical Side Lane routing. Ask first or Just go mode controls implementation approval: Ask first stops for the user's approval of the brief and staffing; Just go proceeds once original task scope and action/tool gates are satisfied, with no separate brief approval.
defaultPrompt: Research this request and draft a brief for review.
